senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אנק, חנק)to be narrow, elongated; denom. עֲנָק, עוּנְקָא &c.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:7">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> (expl. <he>עֲנָקִים</he>) <he>שהיו עוֹנְקִים גלגל חמה ואומרים הורד וכ׳</he> they seized the globe of the sun and said, Send us rain down; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 47:1">Yalk. ib. 47</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:13">Num. R. s. 16</cite> (ref. to <he>ילידי הענק</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 13:28">Num. XIII, 28</cite>) <he>שראוהו שהיה עוֹנֵק את השמש</he> they (the spies) saw him force the sun (to give rain); Tanḥ. Shlaḥ 7.
Yoma 10ᵃ (ref. to Num. l. c.) שמַעֲנִיקִין החמה בקומתן they lorded it over the sun by virtue of their height; Sot. 34ᵇ (Rashi: they had the appearance of squeezing their heads into the sun).

senses.gloss: [to suspend around the neck, load,] to outfit the emancipated slave with gifts (Deut. XV, 14). Y. Kidd. I, 59ᶜ bot. אילו שמַעֲנִיקִין להן וכ׳ the following are those who must be sent away with gifts; Bab.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 16b:19">Ib.</cite> <he>יכול לא יהיו מַעֲנִיקִים וכ׳</he> you might think that only he who is discharged after the expiration of six years of servitude, must be outfitted.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 119:2">Sifré Deut. 119</cite> <he>שאם הֶעֱנַקְתָּ … תַּעֲנִיק לו וכ׳</he> that when thou hast outfitted him once, thou must do it again &c. Kidd. l. c. <he>כמה מעניקים לו</he> how much must he be given?; a. fr.
